int doubleUtil(ListNode* head) {
    if (head == nullptr) return 0;                     // empty list → no carry

    int carry = doubleUtil(head->next);               // propagate carry from next node
    int newVal = (head->val) * 2 + carry;            // compute new digit
    head->val = newVal % 10;                         // store least‑significant digit

    return newVal / 10;                              // propagate carry to caller
}
